dax_measures.name: Positive Review Rate
dax_measures.description: Ratio of positive to total ratings, aggregated across all matching games — never an average of per-game rates, which would over-weight low-review titles.

dax_measures.name: Total Games
dax_measures.description: Row count of the fact table for the current filter context.

dax_measures.name: Avg Price Paid
dax_measures.description: Mean listed price across non-free games only.
